title: fix(searchFunction): implement another way to express #1924 API
body:
The new approach is less subtle than the previous one: instead of
overloading the search method using the helper as a prototype, we change
the implementation of the search on the fly.

Fixes #2176

**Summary**

We couldn't bind the events `search` and `result` in the previous implementation

**Result**

 - go to http://debonair-current.surge.sh/
 - open the console and see the different log message created by event listeners :)

> Read and re-read again I did not find any obvious flaw that will break.

Good to know. Given the current context, which is modifying the parameters before sending the request, it will be fine indeed. But what you introduce some async in there :) Like for example you do a first query to check another index, and then you trigger the search. The code will go on and change back the reference to the search function. In this case we might end up in a loopy situation :)

Knowing the caveat, we are able to document that though. WDYT? @vvo
Now that I think about it, is it still doable to implement debouncing with this? If not that's fine if we provide a way to do debouncing :D
